---
title: "Encampment Reports Across Nine Council Districts"
format:
  html:
    embed-resources: true
execute:
  message: false
---

This notebook builds a shared monthly series for comparing forecasting models. All nine district extracts use `Encampment` in the `service_name` column. Each distinct service request is counted in its reported calendar month.

The baseline runs from October 2018 through October 2026. Matching reports first appear during August or September 2018, depending on the district, and the extracts end on November 1, 2026.

```{r}
library(readr)
library(dplyr)
library(tsibble)
library(fpp3)

# Find the district files from the repo root or the notebooks folder.
data_dir <- "C:/Users/ekali/Downloads/ADS_506_Final_Project-main/ADS_506_Final_Project-main/data"

files <- file.path(data_dir,
  sprintf("get_it_done_requests_CD%d_datasd.csv.gz", 1:9))

# Read and combine the nine files, keeping only the columns we need.
reports <- read_csv(
  files,
  col_select = c(service_request_id, date_requested, service_name),
  show_col_types = FALSE
)

# Count distinct encampment reports by the month they were submitted.
monthly_counts <- reports |>
  filter(service_name == "Encampment") |>
  mutate(Month = yearmonth(date_requested)) |>
  group_by(Month) |>
  summarise(Requests = n_distinct(service_request_id))

# Start with the shared calendar so months with no reports get a zero.
months <- seq(yearmonth("2018 Oct"), yearmonth("2026 Oct"), by = 1)
encampment_monthly <- tibble(Month = months) |>
  left_join(monthly_counts, by = "Month") |>
  mutate(Requests = coalesce(Requests, 0L)) |>
  as_tsibble(index = Month)

encampment_monthly
```

```{r}
train <- encampment_monthly |>
  filter(Month <= yearmonth("2025 Oct"))

test <- encampment_monthly |>
  filter(Month >= yearmonth("2025 Nov"))

nrow(train)
nrow(test)
```
```{r}
# Manual and automatic ETS models
fits <- train |>
  model(manual = ETS(Requests ~ error("A") + trend("Ad") + season("N")),
    auto = ETS(Requests))

fits
glance(fits)
```

```{r}
# Forecast the next 12 months
forecasts <- fits |>
  forecast(h = 12)

# Manual ETS forecast
forecasts |>
  filter(.model == "manual") |>
  autoplot(encampment_monthly) +
  labs(title = "Manual ETS Forecast",
       x = "Month",
       y = "Encampment Reports")

# Automatic ETS forecast
forecasts |>
  filter(.model == "auto") |>
  autoplot(encampment_monthly) +
  labs(title = "Automatic ETS Forecast",
       x = "Month",
       y = "Encampment Reports")
```
```{r}
accuracy(forecasts, test) |>
  select(.model, RMSE, MAE, MAPE)
```

Log transformation
```{r}
encampment_monthly |>
  mutate(Log_Requests = log1p(Requests)) |>
  select(Month, Requests, Log_Requests) |>
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(Requests, Log_Requests),
    names_to = "Series",
    values_to = "Value") |>
  ggplot(aes(x = Month, y = Value)) +
  geom_line() +
  facet_wrap(~ Series, scales = "free_y", ncol = 1) +
  labs(
    title = "Original and Log-Transformed Encampment Reports",
    x = "Month",
    y = "Value")

```
```{r}
log_fit <- train |> model(Log_ETS = ETS(log1p(Requests)))

report(log_fit)

```
```{r}
log_forecasts <- log_fit |>
  forecast(h = 12)

original_accuracy <- accuracy(forecasts, test) |>
  select(.model, RMSE, MAE, MAPE)

transformed_accuracy <- accuracy(log_forecasts, test) |>
  select(.model, RMSE, MAE, MAPE)

bind_rows(original_accuracy, transformed_accuracy)

```
```{r}
log_forecasts |>
  autoplot(
    encampment_monthly |>
      filter(Month >= yearmonth("2024 Nov"))) +
  autolayer(log_fit |>
      augment() |>
      filter(Month >= yearmonth("2024 Nov")),
    .fitted,
    color = "green") +
  labs(title = "Log-Transformed ETS Forecast",
    x = "Month",
    y = "Number of Encampment Reports")
```

Square root transformation
```{r}
sqrt_fit <- train |>
  model(Sqrt_ETS = ETS(sqrt(Requests)))

report(sqrt_fit)

sqrt_forecasts <- sqrt_fit |>
  forecast(h = 12)

accuracy(sqrt_forecasts, test) |>
  select(.model, RMSE, MAE, MAPE)

```
Box-Cox transformation
```{r}
boxcox_fit <- train |>
  model(
    BoxCox_025 = ETS(box_cox(Requests, 0.25)),
    BoxCox_050 = ETS(box_cox(Requests, 0.50)),
    BoxCox_075 = ETS(box_cox(Requests, 0.75)))

report(boxcox_fit)

boxcox_forecasts <- boxcox_fit |>
  forecast(h = 12)

accuracy(boxcox_forecasts, test) |>
  select(.model, RMSE, MAE, MAPE)

```
Seasonality transformation
```{r}
encampment_monthly |>
  gg_season(Requests, labels = "both") +
  labs(title = "Seasonal Patterns in Encampment Reports",
    y = "Number of Reports")

```
```{r}

encampment_monthly |>
  model(STL(Requests ~ season(window = "periodic"))) |>
  components() |>
  autoplot() +
  labs(title = "Seasonal Decomposition of Encampment Reports")

```
```{r}
seasonal_fit <- train |>
  model(
    Log_No_Season = ETS(
      log1p(Requests) ~ error("A") +
        trend("N") + season("N")),
    Log_Seasonal = ETS(
      log1p(Requests) ~ error("A") +
        trend("N") + season("A")))

report(seasonal_fit)

seasonal_forecasts <- seasonal_fit |>
  forecast(h = 12)

accuracy(seasonal_forecasts, test) |>
  select(.model, RMSE, MAE, MAPE)

```
